outcome: NFkB activators (NIK, IKKa, IKKb, CK2a) gene expression
Ratios of NFkB activators to inhibitors
cohort: The study included placentas from 130 preeclamptic women and 138 normotensive control women.
finding: Preeclamptic placentas demonstrated significantly lower IKKa and CK2a but higher IkBa and IkBb protein levels, suggesting a downregulation of canonical, non-canonical, and atypical NFkB activation pathways and potentially involvement of other mechanisms.
